clue.text: George rewriting Act I to omit Paul

indicators.note: rewriting a text reshapes it, so the letters of these four words are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone redrafting a play cuts out a character called Paul from the first act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'George' looks like a person's name; it is old RAF slang for the autopilot of an aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: Airmen's slang named the plane's self-steering device George, a nickname for the self-flying system.

clue.text: "Caesar's Wife" must be a television series

definitions.meaning: completes the proverb that Caesar's wife must be free of any hint of wrongdoing
a British ITV police drama starring Kelly Reilly as a detective

explanation.surface: A claim that a drama titled after Caesar's wife ought to become a TV series.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says Caesar's wife must be beyond reproach, and the phrase is also the title of an ITV crime drama.

clue.text: Cars not used in search party rummaging for cure

indicators.note: says the letters of the first word are left out of the pool being worked with
rummaging through something stirs it about, so the remaining letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A search party combs the area on foot, without vehicles, hunting for a remedy.
explanation.walkthrough: Take C, A, R, S out of SEARCHPARTY to leave EHPARTY, then rearrange those seven.
explanation.definitionFit: Therapy is treatment intended to heal, so it serves as a synonym for a remedy.

clue.text: Demanding treatment for vexatious

indicators.note: giving something treatment works it over, so the word's letters are reprocessed into a new order

explanation.surface: A demanding course of medical care can be very irritating.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something that annoys or irritates, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Boxer's handle for 1977 film

definitions.meaning: the biopic in which Muhammad Ali played himself

explanation.surface: A boxer's nickname is used as the title of a film from 1977.
explanation.definitionFit: Muhammad Ali called himself by this superlative nickname, and his 1977 biopic took it as its title.

clue.text: Finish without a bed

indicators.note: says the letter a is dropped from the word before it

parts.note: a finishing coat of paint or varnish is a coat

explanation.surface: Completing a job without a bed to sleep in.
explanation.definitionFit: A cot is a small bed, especially one with sides for a baby.

clue.text: See 1
Organ in place of a jewel

indicators.note: puts the organ inside the abbreviation for place

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names
the ear is the organ of hearing

explanation.surface: A musical organ installed somewhere instead of a jewel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organ' suggests a musical instrument, but it is a body part.
explanation.definitionFit: A pearl is a gem formed in an oyster, treasured as jewellery.

clue.text: Let rain wash the public toilet

indicators.note: washing churns things up, so the letters of the two words are mixed

explanation.surface: An invitation to let the rain clean a public lavatory.
explanation.definitionFit: A latrine is a communal lavatory, typically a basic one in a camp or barracks.

clue.text: Chain letters Sal omitted rewritten as mournful

indicators.note: says the letters of the name Sal are taken out of the pool
rewriting reshapes text, so the letters left are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone redrafts a chain letter, leaves out Sal, and the result is gloomy.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove S, A, L from CHAINLETTERS to leave CHINETTER, then rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Threnetic describes a threnody, a lament for the dead, so it means sorrowful.

clue.text: Behind schedule on subscription? Not quite

parts.note: on can mean over, as in a picture on or over the fireplace

indicators.note: says the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: membership fees for a club are its dues

explanation.surface: A late membership payment, asked whether it is nearly but not exactly due.
explanation.definitionFit: Something late, past the time it was expected, is a synonym for behind schedule.

clue.text: Rat! Riot! Rat! Riot!

indicators.note: to run riot is to go wild, so the words before it are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A chant or shouted slogan about rats and rioting.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated words look like noise; the first 'Rat' is the definition and the last 'Riot' scrambles the middle two.
explanation.definitionFit: A rat in slang is a betrayer who deserts or informs on their own side.

clue.text: Cheer the Spanish goddess of mischief

parts.note: el is the Spanish for 'the'
Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin

explanation.surface: Cheering on a Spanish goddess who causes trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To cheer someone is to raise their spirits, to make them happy.

clue.text: British rugby player behind guerrilla insurgence

indicators.note: places the rugby player after the guerrilla

parts.note: a guerrilla fighter is a rebel
a Lion plays for the British and Irish Lions touring rugby team

explanation.surface: A British rugby player is stuck behind a guerrilla fighter in an uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: An insurgence is an uprising against authority, which is what a revolt is.

clue.text: Red tape to install air- conditioning in office by Currys odd

parts.note: a bureau is an office or agency

indicators.note: says the abbreviation is fitted inside the other letters
picks the letters in the odd positions of the shop's name

parts.note: AC is the usual abbreviation for air-conditioning

explanation.surface: Official paperwork needed before a shop like Currys can fit air-conditioning in an office.
explanation.walkthrough: Currys is a UK chain selling electrical goods; 'odd' takes its first, third and fifth letters. 'install' puts the air-conditioning just before the last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Red tape is the excessive paperwork and procedure of officialdom, an idiom for administrative obstruction.

clue.text: State power

definitions.meaning: to state is to declare or speak
having a ... means having influence over a decision

explanation.definitionFit: To state something is to utter it; and a voice or influence in a decision is having one.

clue.text: See 1
United me with Argentine doctor

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone says they were joined in marriage to an Argentine physician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' looks like a noun, a physician, but it is a verb meaning to falsify.
explanation.definitionFit: People who agree are of one mind, so they are united on the matter.

clue.text: Basic English to the French intellectual

parts.note: le is French for 'the'
mental means of the intellect

explanation.surface: Elementary English set against a cultured French thinker.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fundamental or primary is basic, the essential building block.

clue.text: Fired a red sten gun? No, another weapon

indicators.note: fired here means set off or blasted, so the letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Asking whether a red Sten submachine gun was fired, and answering that a different arm was used.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another weapon' refers back to the Sten gun named in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A stun grenade is a non-lethal explosive device, a different arm from a Sten gun.

clue.text: Vain Monica in the States

indicators.note: puts the tennis player's surname inside the abbreviation for America

parts.note: US stands for the United States
Monica Seles, the tennis champion

explanation.surface: Monica, conceited and living in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Vain in the sense of futile, as in a vain attempt, means to no avail.

clue.text: Reptile decapitated by monster bird

indicators.note: having its head cut off means the first letter goes

parts.note: croc is short for crocodile, a reptile

explanation.surface: A crocodile has its head bitten off by a giant bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The roc is the gigantic mythical bird of Arabian legend, in the Sinbad stories.

clue.text: Gunner home with weapon shaped thus

definitions.text: Gunner home with weapon shaped thus

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, whose soldiers are gunners
in means at home
a bow is a weapon for shooting arrows

explanation.surface: An artillery soldier at home with a weapon shaped like the answer.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the answer: an arc in the sky shaped like the archer's weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A rainbow forms an arc across the sky, the same curve as an archer's bow.

clue.text: The Sentinel, a stickler for holding rigid

indicators.note: the phrase holds the answer within its letters, spanning word boundaries

explanation.surface: A newspaper called The Sentinel is a stickler for something.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unable to stretch or bend is rigid, without give.

clue.text: Inability to co-ordinate movements within USA tax year

indicators.note: says the answer lies inside the run of letters that follows

explanation.surface: A motor disorder somehow appearing inside the American financial year.
explanation.definitionFit: Ataxy, or ataxia, is a neurological loss of muscle control and coordination.

clue.text: Order from editor, principally involving cadet training

indicators.note: takes the leading letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: An editor issues an instruction concerning the drilling of cadets.
explanation.definitionFit: An edict is an official decree or command from authority.

clue.text: He is keen to cram rye into empty transporter

indicators.note: cramming stuffs one thing inside another
says where the grain goes: inside the outer letters
an emptied word keeps only its outside letters

explanation.surface: A worker eager to load rye into an empty truck.
explanation.definitionFit: One who tries hard, giving full effort, is an eager, keen person.

clue.text: Popular former legislative enactment is muddled

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
ex means former, as in ex-wife
an act is a statute passed by parliament

explanation.surface: A once-popular law has become confused.
explanation.definitionFit: Muddled figures are imprecise and not correct, which matches the answer's sense.

clue.text: Cruise with Noddy the fool

definitions.meaning: a tomnoddy is a fool or simpleton, so this name joins Noddy to make the word for a fool

explanation.surface: Going on a cruise with Noddy, the foolish toy character.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the actor's first name, and joined to noddy it forms the old word tomnoddy, a dolt.

clue.text: A non-drinking lad receiving a word of encouragement

indicators.note: says the second a is taken inside the rest

parts.note: TT is teetotal, abstaining from alcohol
a boy is a lad

explanation.surface: A sober youngster is given some encouraging words.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an informal exclamation of praise, like 'well done', urging someone on.

clue.text: Inquisitive — negative turning positive

parts.note: no is a negative reply

indicators.note: turning means the affirmative word is read backwards

parts.note: yes is a positive reply

explanation.surface: A shift of answer from no to yes, or a pessimist turning optimist.
explanation.definitionFit: A nosy person pries into others' affairs, so is curious, prying.

clue.text: Hawthorn may blossom on transatlantic ship

definitions.meaning: the flower of the may tree, as hawthorn is called
the Pilgrims' ship that sailed to America in 1620

explanation.surface: Hawthorn may bloom aboard a ship crossing the Atlantic.
explanation.definitionFit: Hawthorn is called may, so its bloom has this name, shared with the Pilgrim Fathers' vessel of 1620.
